youtube.title: Why You Can't Sneeze With Your Eyes Open 🤧 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Your eyes won't pop out if you sneeze with them open. A sneeze is a reflex run by your brainstem, and along with the blast of air it fires the nerves that shut your eyelids. The pressure of a sneeze comes from your chest, not from behind your eyes, so closing them is just part of the reflex, not protection from popping.
